feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a heap buffer overflow when encoding JXL image with a 16-bit float
entry.content:
The JXL encoder has an heap write overflow when a user specifies that the image should be encoded as 16 bit floats.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-jvgr-9ph5-m8v4
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40183
  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/commit/1c7767fc5f822c6edc104c1220d523e96fa20b5a
  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/releases/tag/7.1.2-19
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.12.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jvgr-9ph5-m8v4

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a heap buffer overflow (WRITE) in the YAML and JSON encoders.

A crafted image could result in an out of bounds heap write when writing a yaml or json output and that could result in a crash.
